user.title: One Shot
user.description: Let Assist set up 'when X happens, do Y once' rules. Choose what a One Shot may control and who may use it. Admins can always use it.

data.allowed_domains: Device types a One Shot may control
data.admin_only_domains: Device types only admins may control (subset of the above)
data.allowed_users: Non-admin users allowed to use One Shot (empty = all users)
data.allow_anonymous: Allow requests where the speaker isn't identified (e.g. voice satellites)
data.log_requests: Log every Assist request and response (for debugging)
